WITH RECURSIVE sku_reach(root_sku_id, child_kind, child_code, path_qty) AS (
    SELECT
        s.sku_id,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        CAST(c.qty AS BIGINT) AS path_qty
    FROM sales_sku AS s
    JOIN u_composition AS c
      ON c.parent_kind = 'sku'
     AND c.parent_code = s.sku_code
     AND c.child_kind IN ('sku', 'model')

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        r.root_sku_id,
        c.child_kind,
        c.child_code,
        r.path_qty * c.qty AS path_qty
    FROM sku_reach AS r
    JOIN u_composition AS c
      ON c.parent_kind = r.child_kind
     AND c.parent_code = r.child_code
     AND c.child_kind IN ('sku', 'model')
    WHERE r.child_kind = 'sku'
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ol.qty * r.path_qty), 0) AS units_sold
FROM sku_reach AS r
JOIN company_model AS m
  ON r.child_kind = 'model'
 AND r.child_code = m.model_code
JOIN listing AS l
  ON l.sku_id = r.root_sku_id
JOIN order_line AS ol
  ON ol.listing_id = l.listing_id
JOIN orders AS o
  ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
WHERE m.model_code = 'VI1-140WHT65-0259'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
